name: Weathered Brush Stamp
description: Distressed hand-brushed capitals, stamped in thick paint and left rough at the edges.
phrase: lettering hand-brushed in thick paint and stamped onto a rough surface, distressed broken edges, dry-brush gaps and skipped strokes through the letterforms, uneven pressure, a single flat colour in bone white or oxblood, completely matte with no glow, no outline and no shadow
